serviceName: Landings de Miniemail en tu dominio
description: Points the creator's publishing subdomain (the standard host parameter, e.g. host=go or host=landing) to Miniemail's landing servers with a single CNAME to landings.miniemail.io. Always applied with a host; never at the zone apex. DNS only (not proxied): Miniemail verifies the CNAME before issuing the TLS certificate.
variableDescription: No variables: the subdomain comes in the standard host parameter.
